Docket 1.3.116

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A page written in two languages is no longer called mislabelled.* An English page that lists events in
  Spanish was reported as Spanish under an English label, as if it were a translation. When the declared language
  carries a good share of the page too, the page is bilingual, and Docket says nothing. A translation labelled as
  the original is still reported.
- *A phone link written as XXX-XXX-XXXX is called a placeholder, not a vanity number.* A directory entry whose
  number was never filled in was reported as letters in a vanity number, with advice to keep the printed number,
  which was the same placeholder. It is now reported as an unfilled placeholder to replace. A real vanity number
  is still reported as before.
- *A sitemap entry with the site's address written twice is named for what it is.* An entry like
  site.com/https://site.com/page was reported as a doubled slash that serves the same page as the clean address,
  with the wrong cause. It now says the address is written twice, that such an entry usually answers "not found",
  and how to fix the generator. Doubled slashes inside a path keep their own explanation.

99 checks across 13 areas.
